Thank you for contributing to the 2D Geospatial Climate Digital Twin!

### Branch Type
<!-- Please ensure your branch follows the naming conventions: feature/, bugfix/, or docs/ -->
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] Documentation / Rules

### Description
Please provide a brief summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

### Reviewer Checklist
- [ ] Modified math expressions render correctly without KaTeX parse errors.
- [ ] Verified that Streamlit launches cleanly (`streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py`) without caching errors.
- [ ] Confirmed `config.json` is not tracked and only `config.json.example` is present.
- [ ] Ran verification scripts (`check_downloaded_data.py`, `decode_imd_binary.py`, `decode_imd_temp.py`) and all tests passed.
